reviews.title: Attention scam: Hands off Corsair!
reviews.text: Booking number: WJC9CM; PTP - SJU An hour after I booked the ticket, the flight was cancelled by phone (Raphael). The replacement date was cancelled a few hours later and I was offered a refund as the only option. The refund has not arrived to this day! I have been arguing with the service for months and they are not helpful at all. Not one apology for making me re-organize all travel plans (hotel, rental car etc), incl extra costs.
reviews.author: Frederic W.

reviews.title: Terrible airlines, would never book with them again
reviews.text: My flight from Martinique was delayed for NEARLY 3 hours, in effect I missed my connecting flight to London. I had to buy another flight, change airports, and missed all my arrangements of getting home to England it cost me additional money and they refused to refund me because the flight was delayed for less than 3 hours. They don't give a damn about their customers. No help at the airport, no one speaks English, and the crew was not helpful and with a very little English understanding. My claim has been refused. Overall very very bad experience.
reviews.author: Kamila S

reviews.title: Zero communication
reviews.text: Called France and US numbers. Even online chat. Woke up early to do so. No one answered. I called Travelocity a number of times and they offered to call Corsair each time. They were unable to get through to Corsair either. These calls were made after we left the airport, unable to make the flight due to the crowd of thousands of people trying to get through security. At the airport, customer service reps were rude and unhelpful, and then nonexistent (no one at their desk at all!) to rebook a flight or communicate what to do about the chaotic state of the security lines at Trudeau airport. A costly mistake I will not make with them again.
reviews.author: Curls

reviews.title: Returning to USA
reviews.text: We would have missed our flight if my wife and I had not taken cuts in check in line… I counted about 100 plus people waiting in line and non of the Corsair staff spoke English. I will let all in US know that this is not the airline to use in Europe.
reviews.author: Gary T

reviews.title: They put a small plane for a 8 hour flight!
reviews.text: The airline decided to choose a plane much too small for the flight of 8 hours. There was no room for peoples luggage it was horrible Our flight got delayed 2 hours because of their poor management. Also my seat was broken and the plane was old and small
reviews.author: Corsair sucks

reviews.title: Canada to France, Paris
reviews.text: This is so bad never come to Corsair airline again, there costumer service is terrible, they don’t care about us they made me wait 3 days for them to say nothing, they can’t even get us another plane because they have only 1 plane. So Now we have to wait for 1 month to go to our next plane. Never take Corsair airline.
reviews.author: Johnston doe

reviews.title: An Awful Company Who’s Staff Are Ashamed To Work For
reviews.text: We were due to fly for the Canada for the premier of our feature film. The airline refused to allow my wife on the flight as their system had not been updated to show that UAE Nationals could fly to Canada with a ETA not a full visa. This change occurred in 2018!!! Their system had not been updated for 4 years!!! The check in staff agreed that we should be able to fly but they could not override the system to generate a boarding pass!!!! In the company’s system’s eyes we did not have the documents to travel, although we did, so check-in staff were not sure if we will even get our money back!!!! They also said not to use their wifi or the mobile app for refunds as their IT systems were not good. No Sh!t!!!! This has cost us thousands of dollars and meant that we missed a once in a lifetime experience. It also means that our audience in Montréal miss out on what they paid for, a conversation with the directors of a film that they are going to be one of the first to watch in the world. The check-in staff were lovely, but frustrated and shamed by the company they were working for. The desk manager said she was looking for another job. I wish her all the best!
reviews.author: kenton9

reviews.title: Did not return my funds after they cancelled my flight! They stole €2000 and they won't return it. Help!!!!!
reviews.text: First of all, the cancelled my flight and I had to request a refund. Then the horror show started. I applied for a refund and it's been half a year. I called them over and over and emailed them. They claimed they didn't have my bank details. Then they promised to issue it right away. 3 month later, nothing. After emailing three more times, they said they sent it last year...before my flight was cancelled!! These guys are crooks!! Avoid!!!
reviews.author: Mark L

reviews.title: 2 Passengers have to pay extra to sit together
reviews.text: Horrible service, I have never in my entire life experienced any airliner who refuses to seat 2 passengers together... until flying with Corsair. I was given seat 46D while my girlfriend was given seat 14K... When trying to change seat upon check-in it showed literally EVERY OTHER SEAT as PREMIUM and had to pay between 15-40 EUR extra in order to change seat. There was nothing premium about these seats as our seats 46D and 14K both showed up as 'PREMIUM' seats as well as soon as we changed to other seats. Horrible practise to force people extra money out of their pockets just to be able to sit together on a 9 hour flight. Even one star is too much in my opinion.
reviews.author: Melv1337

reviews.title: Staff misread Covid rules, lacked geographical knowledge and we nearly missed our flight
reviews.text: We were checking in at Marseille, France to fly to Reunion Island (also French territory). My partner is French and I hold a UK passport. Because French Overseas Territories all have different rules about entering during Covid, we triple-checked the requirements beforehand: all we needed was proof that we had been vaccinated. What could possibly go wrong? We got there 3 hours before boarding time just to be safe. At the check-in counter, my partner checks in without a hitch. When the airline staff saw my passport, she did a double take, as if it had never occurred to her that anyone non-French would travel to Reunion Island. She asked, 'Are you sure that you don't require a visa to travel to Reunion Island, with your British passport?' I also do a double-take. We were *already in France*. Why would I need a visa to travel to another French territory? Sure, there was Brexit, but we were definitely not at the point of requesting visas from British people to travel in the EU! So I said no, I'm quite sure I don't need a visa to travel to...France...since I'm...already in France...and I got here without a visa just several days ago. She then double checks and says, okay yes, you're right, BUT it says here on this official airline database that British people require 1) a vaccination certificate AND 2) a negative test result in order to fly to France. And I'm like...no. According to the official UK gov site and Reunion site, I don't need both, just either. I also was able to fly to
reviews.author: Elle B.

reviews.title: Still no refund
reviews.text: Still waiting for refund. Supposed to travel in July 2020 - everything got canceled, got voucher, but in 2021 company stopped all flights from USA. Ask for a refund in June 2021. In December 2021 they are still didn't refund money and keep asking me for RIB every month - even though I provided this several times. All communications from the company sent in French - riiight. They used to have a rep in US who was helpful, but the person is no longer working for them and Montreal office is simply does not pick up the phone. Stay away from this company and if you in US you can't booked anything with them since no more flights from US.
reviews.author: jsmith95

reviews.title: Terrible communication
reviews.text: Bought ticket for May 2020 but cancelled due to Covid. Have been trying for over a MONTH now to get my money back but they have been completely unresponsive by email and phone. My claim has been filed but uncertain if they will ever actually review it.
reviews.author: Kimia O

reviews.title: Refund not received, inexistent customer service
reviews.text: Bought a flight in February 2020, cancelled due to COVID March 2020. At the time tried unsuccessfully to contact the company by phone - impossible given the events, but also expensive, since it is a toll number. Opened a customer service ticket. I can only see it was "Treated", yet have no communication of the way it was treated. Impossible to know whether the refund was approved or not. Travel agent (Travel2be) did not refund yet, claim they are waiting fr the airline refund. I would avoid both in the future.
reviews.author: RADU M

reviews.title: Still waiting for a refund
reviews.text: I have booked a trip to Martinique with corsair through a third party GOTOGATE. Basically lost 1200 euros, from rebooking tickets from March to June and finally June to September. Finally Gotogate advice me to get an open ticket on which I could use whenever needed until December 2021. they have gone quiet for 2 months and after many calls, they have responded to me that the Airline denied my request, where I basically lost all my money. PLEASE AVOID BOOKING TICKET WITH CORSAIR. They barely speak any english and all the forms provided are written in French. I have been contacting Gotogate and they say to contact Corsair, whereas Corsair keep saying to contact Gotogate. AVOID AT ALL COSTS.
reviews.author: Adriano F

reviews.title: Still waiting for reimbursement
reviews.text: It is now one year that we are waiting for the reimbursement of our flights . The travel agency travelgenio tried to assure us several times that Corsair will reimburse us, but after one year most of our hope is gone. If this reimbursement does not happen we will try to use other channels, this is impossible, it is creating an important hole in our personal budget. Reference number: 17730208
reviews.author: Pascal K

reviews.title: Corsair
reviews.text: People please I never write a review about anything, but today I must inform everyone that not buy any flights or service with this airline. I lost 1981 dollars. I was scheduled to flights ✈️ to Paris on June and they canceled my flight and until now every time I called gotogate which was the third party agency when I booked the flight gotogate tell me to call Corsair and when I call Corsair the tell me that I have to call (Go to gate ). In fact, I have lost my 1981 dollars and every time I call them they say they will refund me the money but I have to wait. It has been six months since I bought the tickets and still I haven't heard back from them.
reviews.author: Varios M

reviews.title: Pathetic Company
reviews.text: Horrible customer service, cant get anyone to help, only sends forms in french. They take days to respond to you. Then just say they are sorry. They got at least that part right. They are SORRY.
reviews.author: Charles W

reviews.title: Corsair and trip.com continue to cheat
reviews.text: Booked flight with Corsair Airlines on January 20, 2020. Never received a confirmation or a ticked issued from airlines, but only from trip.com. After Coronavirus outbreak I enquired several times to both Corsair (via phone and email) and trip.com on the status of my flight. The former never replied, the latter kept on confirming the flight as live and greened. On March 23 I have found an update regarding my flight on Corsair's official website stating that it had been canceled. Contacted again both corsair and trip.com providing them with the evidence found. Only trip.com replied and denied having updates on my flight refusing to answer for the details of my refund and redirecting me to contact again Corsair asking them for a 'written statement'(whaaat??). Corsair still fails to answer. To this day I am still denied the refund for the flight booked and the service the carrier canceled. P.S. Easyjet has promptly refunded my connecting flight two weeks ago.
reviews.author: alan m

reviews.title: Onboard service
reviews.text: It happened to me twice. The first time I thought that the agent was in bad mood ( not enough sleep, not feeling well....) but the second time around I begin to believe it is the company ‘s policy ( the flight was from Montreal to Paris at 19:45 on March 12, 2020 ) I am 68 year's old and 1m55. Each time I asked the agent onboard to help me to stuck my hand luggage in the compartiment above my seat the answer was the same: « no, you have to do it by yourself » and both times I have to rely on a good samaritain for assistance. I travel around 4 times/year and only encounter this kind of treatment with Corsair. This time due the coronavirus I had to cut short my stay in Paris and booked a one way flight to go back to Montreal. The AC’s attendants, despite the stressful situation, were courteous and helpful. I do not recommend Corsair to any old-aged travellers.who would need help because you would not have it. Tran Nguyen Hoai Thu
reviews.author: Tran Thu

reviews.title: SCAM (does not accept to modify/cancel) due to corona virus
reviews.text: SCAM company. CORSAIR (french company) has a very bad reputation and a very bad customer service. They work with ORTBITZ (agency). If you want to postpone a flight (or cancel) due to the corona virus, they said you need to contact ORBITZ. And when you contact ORBITZ, they say you need to contact the CORSAIR company. SCAM. $1500 lost. Need to call my credit card company now. I lost 5 days to try to reach their customers services.
reviews.author: Aurelien A

reviews.title: Very pleasant flight of more than 12 hours from La Reunion to Paris.
reviews.text: Very friendly staff, clean plane. We left well in time? During the flight we also got plenty of food and drinks. Nothing to complain about.
reviews.author: JimmyVanNoten

reviews.title: Over 8-hour flight - no food or drink
reviews.text: My parents flew with Corsair in early 2019 from Martinique to Paris. They were offered no food or drinks (even water!) during the flight, which takes over 8 hours. The plane was cold, so they asked for blankets - they were told they'd have to pay €15 for a blanket. Most definitely will be avoiding Corsair!
reviews.author: Em K

reviews.title: Horrible Experience with Corsair.
reviews.text: I travel with my wife and my youngest son from Miami to Paris with corsair. I booked my tickets through orbitz. When I booked, I saved my booking confirmation screenshot which is the only proof that save my money from rip off. When I booked, it's clearly stated one bag check in is free up to 23 kg. So we are all took one piece of luggage to check in as 23 kg. When we check in at Miami airport Corsair counter, They said I have to pay $115.00 each for our one piece check in luggage, I show them my screenshot of my booking. Then they said that we don't know because you book through third party travel agent. I said I always book through orbitz and never had any issues with them. I also booked another flight from Paris to Bangalore, India through orbitz which was Etihad airways which I never had any problems to check in my bag as orbitz stated on my booking. When I came back form France to Miami, Corsair charge me another 100 euro each for our one pices. For this trip my budget was $1500 for paris trip and I took cash with me. But, traveling with cors air it's hurt me big time because they took my $645.00 for the luggage and we end up with $865.00 budget. So, We couldn't do much for the little budget and corsair ruin our 25th year wedding anniversary trip. We were so disappointed. I thank Etihad air ways to provide a fat better service with their A380 flight from Paris to Bangalore. They didn't fake us and charge extra money for our luggage. Etihad air kept their promise and gave
reviews.author: Tomson Chacko

reviews.title: Below zero customer service follow up on several issues
reviews.text: Experience to share to all people who plan to travel with Corsair International from / to Montréal.... or anywhere else we book our flights to go back in france to see our families for Christmas holidays. We have experienced the below zero customer service follow up. On the way to Paris, one of our 2 seats was broken. This had not just happened no no the hostess told us « ah yes this seat is a bit temperamental... let me ask my colleague to try to fix it »... so for 15 minutes a crew member tried to have the seat moving and well he did not... A little shame when you on purpose of getting some rest specifically réserve business class.... We fill a complaint online .... and receive a sorry email stating ... well sorry here is a 70€ discount for your next trip with us.... Not even the half of the difference between economic seat and business... we argue this discount as we don’t feel it is compensating... no answer to our email. I call the customer service. First call the agent listen to the purpose of my call and put me on hold.... for 15 minutes ... simply waiting that I put down the phone.... I call back, the person starts to investigate the case and after 19 minutes oh well the line cuts.... am i not unlucky??!! So 3rd call and there I have the agent telling me sorry I can’t anything. For any possible upgrade you have to check directly at the airport when you go back to Montreal... So we did And there first agent send us to a supervisor... can not do anything for us as any r
reviews.author: July555

reviews.title: Terrible service, uncomfortable flight
reviews.text: First off, the only positive aspect: the flight arrived on time.. That's why it gets the second star from me. Everything else was a disaster... The staff was rude, unfriendly and couldn't care less about the passengers. We wanted to switch seats to a free area after completing the boarding and were refused. Other people occupied these seats, just because they switched in secret. Almost no drinks were served in flight, people were referred to the area in the front. Though, 70% of the time the seat belt sign was on although there were almost no turbulences. The food was atrocious.. The seats were old and hardened, the entertainment programme was a joke. I'll avoid that airline in the future and I wouldn't recommend it to anyone else...
reviews.author: Arnold K

reviews.title: OK
reviews.text: As i vowed to never again fly with Air Austral who charged me twice for my return trip from Reunion Island in february and never answered my letters or my E-mails.. I tried Corsair on August. The plane was fully booked but clean and therre was enough legroom. It took off and landed on time The food was miserable and the inboard temperature quite fluctuating. It is a pity we had to pay for our luggages and to get seats next to each other but it seems to be the new airline rules. My son who works over there tried a miserable low cost company only once Corsair is the first choice for many people from Reunion Island and it looks like the best service for its price. My wife had twisted an ankle and they let us board first and asked for a wheelchair at destination Living in Brussels Orly is more complicated to reach than Charles de Gaule but only Air Austral takes off from Charles de Gaule and l won't never fly again with that company
reviews.author: jjsk1

reviews.title: cheap but often delayed or cancelled
reviews.text: This company is ok for the price but flights are often delayed or cancelled. So not good if you don't want to arrive 1 or 2 days after the date planned.

Cheap but full of problems, never again any of my family member or friend will book a flight with them.
